propositions: Eight empty, uncommitted top-level directories exist in the tickets tracker with no CREATE event recorded and no ticket ID registered, reported by fsck as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH findings.

All eight directories meet five safety guards: empty, uncommitted, non-existent per rebar exists, no open file handles, and mtime older than 30 minutes, indicating debris from interrupted writer processes rather than concurrent in-flight writes.

An all-or-nothing tracker-maintenance --clean operation must be guarded by equality check that tracker-maintenance --status foreign list matches exactly the eight triaged directory IDs before any deletion occurs.
Successful cleanup removed all 8 directories and eliminated MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH findings while leaving committed ticket data and benign STATUS_FORK_RESOLVED findings untouched.
No committed Git history was modified; the removed directories were empty and untracked working-tree residue only.
